verdict.rationale: Edge0 is an inference engine with an OpenAI-compatible serve mode, so prefill/decode disaggregation is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack never mentions separating prefill and decode phases or large-scale distributed serving. The cited speedup comes from predicting expert routing and overlapping SSD weight loads with the forward pass, which is a different feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can disaggregate prefill and decode phases for optimized large-scale serving
